verdict.rationale: Superhuman documents AI triage directly. Built-in Auto Labels (Marketing, Pitch, Social, News) classify mail on arrival, Auto Archive clears low-priority mail, split inbox tabs organize it, and replies-needed emails are surfaced with drafts. Users can steer it with custom prompt-based Auto Labels, but only on Business and Enterprise plans. Auditing the AI's decisions (why a message was labeled or archived, review or undo logs, correction feedback) is not documented. Missing for 10: audit trail or explanation of AI triage decisions, a way to correct or retrain labels, steering on all plans, and independent hands-on corroboration of AI labeling accuracy.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, AI triages my inbox for me — auto-labeling, categorizing, and surfacing what needs attention — with behavior I can steer and audit

citations.quote: With Auto Labels, Superhuman Mail automatically classifies incoming messages — so you can focus on what matters most.
Every Superhuman Mail customer can use our built-in Auto Labels: Marketing, Pitch, Social, and News
you can make your own Auto Labels with short AI prompts, and then split your inbox into tabs using these custom Auto Labels.
Custom Auto Labels let you categorize emails with your own AI prompts. (Available for our Business and Enterprise customers.)
Superhuman AI can automatically archive marketing, cold pitches, and social network updates.
Emails are labeled the moment they arrive, so you can see what's important and what's not.
Every email that needs a reply comes with a draft—you can just edit and send.
